namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
open scoped BigOperators
theorem study_a_min_max (x y : ℝ) : min x y + max x y = x + y
:= by
  cases le_or_gt x y with
  | inl h => calc
    min x y + max x y = x + (max x y) : by simp [h]
    ... = x + y : by simp [h]
  | inr h => calc
    min x y + max x y = (min x y) + y : by simp [h]
    ... = x + y : by simp [h]
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : Nl2LeanExpected.study_a_min_max = Nl2LeanCandidate.study_a_min_max := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
